adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the new code does `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and passes it directly to `limit(limit)` without any max bound. That is a real, diff-grounded performance/security-hardening concern (a client can request very large pages). However, the finding overstates “no ceiling like the old 200-cap path”: the prior code for automatic groups also accepted `params[:limit]` without a ceiling, and non-automatic groups previously returned the full member list (effectively unbounded). So this is an improvement opportunity rather than a clearly introduced/observable defect.
